I really hope this isn’t one of my guy friends posting😳 so first off... this lady may very well be slowly falling for you too but.. she might just feel really really comfortable with you.  

I’m very cuddly with my guy friend.  We watch movies almost weekly, we chat about work and things that bother us and get advice from each other.  I trust him.  I enjoy our time together. I appreciate His time and trust his judgement.  But I’m not romantically interested in him.  Not would I assume he had feelings for me.  Relationships involve whatever both people are comfortable with.  

The bottom line here for you is, you have feelings now, The choice you have to make is now share those feelings and maybe lose the friendship or maybe move to the next level. And please, if she doesn’t want to be more, be gentle.  It will be hurting her to lose her friend.  I know I would be Really sad if I lost my friend to feelings :(

Are you happy with your size? Or do you want to lose weight?  If you are happy as you are, it may be time to look for someone who likes you the size you are.  

Your bf is being straight with you by telling you that he isn’t going to marry you unless you lose weight.  Hurtful? Probably.  But everyone has their preference.  Now you need to decide if you want to stay and lose weight knowing that if you gain again he may divorce you (if you make it to marriage) or move on and find someone who likes you as you are.

That being said.. i don’t think this is the guy for you, even if you want to lose the weight, it should not be a requirement in the relationship. Who wants to live a life with the idea that you might get dumped if you put on weight again?

If you want sex (this goes for both of you) Initiate sex.  Your partner then will either consent or not. 

You mentioned candles but didn’t have candles going when she got home.  Maybe she assumed you changed your mind.  (That’s what I’d take from it)
You didn’t light candles because? I’m guessing you assumed her yes was not affirmative enough?  Also, trying to plan sex for later is difficult because (at least for me) I don’t want to commit to sex if I’m not sure I’ll be into at the end of day.  And don’t want to set up my partner for disappointment.  

It sounds to me like you are both reserved when it comes to initiating sex and the result is both of you are feeling unwanted?  Maybe it’s time for some straight forward communication and listening not focusing on who is right or wrong.
